title: An unauthenticated attacker can trick a local user into generating an offline boot application from a malicious…
description: An unauthenticated attacker can deceive a local user into generating an offline boot application from a malicious CODESYS project. This causes the affected products to write files to arbitrary directories on the user's engineering workstation. The attacker controls the destination path, but not the file name or contents. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact confidentiality or availability.
